note: profiles is an ordered array whose position is the baked densityProfile index (C08 SpawnTable). Append-only: a new profile goes at the end; a removal or reorder needs an Architect DL entry and a full re-bake (DL-555). perKm is the peak pedestrians per sidewalk kilometre for the S9 pedSlots formula; the values are design values (BD-M02a2-04). lampPitchM (M02b2) is the street-lamp spacing along Arterial and Collector segments, metres. Later milestones add hour curves, weather and tier factors (M03b1).
